verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a code-sandbox product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes running sandboxes on Cloudflare's own platform (Workers, Durable Objects, containers), and nothing documents a self-hosted deployment. The community comment about a team building their own Firecracker sandbox is a user-side alternative and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
